# TruCore

> Open-source infrastructure for the agent economy. Transaction firewalls, service registries, and agent wallets — MIT-licensed, built for production. Every product ships as a single Go binary an AI agent can install and drive directly.

## Install
- [TruCore Home](https://trucore.xyz): Main landing page with all products.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/trucore-ai): All repositories under trucore-ai organization.

## Products
- [ATF](https://trucore.xyz/docs): Agent Transaction Firewall — policy-enforced guardrails for autonomous agent transactions. Solana-first. Install: `npm i -g @trucore/atf` then `atf trade`.
- [ProvenGraph](https://provengraph.trucore.xyz): MCP service registry with trust scoring. Agents ask "who can do X?" — ProvenGraph returns the best verified server. Install: `go install github.com/trucore-ai/meshdns/cmd/meshdns@latest`.
- [x402Fuel](https://x402fuel.trucore.xyz): Non-custodial HTTP 402 wallet daemon. Give your agent a USDC wallet on Base. Install: `go install github.com/trucore-ai/x402fuel@latest`.

## Documentation
- [ATF Docs](https://trucore.xyz/docs): Full documentation — CLI reference, policy model, receipt verification, getting started.
- [MeshDNS Docs](https://trucore.xyz/docs/meshdns): Architecture, API reference, SDK quickstart (Python + TypeScript), health check model.
- [x402Fuel Docs](https://trucore.xyz/docs/x402fuel): Architecture, CLI reference, budget policy config, E2E payment flow, security model.

## Optional
- [Builders](https://trucore.xyz/builders): For developers building on TruCore infrastructure.
- [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/trucore-ai): Community discussions and roadmap.
